Country and location: Algeria, Blida, 11 km southwest of El Affroun
Notes: Some damage occurred in Blida and Tipaza wilayas. Two people were injured.

Country and location: El Salvador, La Libertad offshore, 32 km south of La Libertad
Notes: Minor damage was caused to a hospital in Santa Tecla and a landslide occurred in the Lago de Coatepeque.

Country and location: Montenegro, Plav Municipality, 9 km northwest of Plav
Notes: Light damage to houses was caused, including cracks in walls and fallen chimneys.

Country and location: Iran, Kermanshah, 16 km north northwest of Sarpol-e Zahab
Notes: 51 people were injured, and additional damage was caused in Sarpol-e Zahab. It was an aftershock of the 2017 Iran–Iraq earthquake.

Country and location: Honduras, Gracias a Dios offshore, 203 km north northeast of Barra Patuca
Notes: The 2018 Swan Islands earthquake caused minor damage, such as cracks in walls. A tsunami was observed with heights of 0.4 m (1.3 ft) in Roatán.

Country and location: Iran, Kermanshah, 16 km east southeast of Mandali, Iraq
Notes: Some old houses were destroyed and 5 people injured. It was an aftershock of the 2017 Iran–Iraq earthquake.

Country and location: Myanmar, Bago, 40 km west southwest of Pyu
Peru, Arequipa offshore, 37 km west of Atiquipa
Notes: During the 2018 Peru earthquake, more than 170 adobe houses collapsed in Arequipa region, and roads were blocked by landslides. Two people died and 139 others were injured.

Country and location: Mexico, Baja California Sur offshore, 79 km north northeast of Loreto
Notes: Slight damage was caused to some buildings, such as cracks on walls and broken windows.

Country and location: Chile, Arica y Parinacota, 100 km east southeast of Arica
Indonesia, Banten offshore, 66 km west of Pelabuhanratu
Notes: The 2018 West Java earthquake damaged hundreds of houses and injured at least eight students, six of them seriously when the roof of their high school collapsed in Cianjur. Two people died of heart attacks in Lebak and Sukabumi and 41 others were injured.

Country and location: United States, Alaska offshore, 261 km southeast of Chiniak
Notes: During the 2018 Gulf of Alaska earthquake, slight damage was reported in Kodiak, and a tsunami-wave of 0.25 m (0.82 ft) was observed.

Country and location: Japan, Aomori offshore, 99 km east northeast of Misawa
Russia, Kamchatka, 259 km east southeast of Ust'-Kamchatsk Staryy
Papua New Guinea, Madang, 188 km north of Madang
Afghanistan, Badakhshan, 37 km south of Jurm
Notes: Some houses were damaged in Afghanistan and Pakistan. One girl was killed and 10 others were injured in Pakistan. Tremors were felt as far away as New Delhi and Islamabad. In Swat Valley, a visitor in a local hotel passed away as a result of a heart attack due to jolts in the building.

Country and location: Pakistan, Balochistan, 11 km northwest of Bela
Notes: A two-year-old girl died when a house collapsed in Lasbela District. Nine other people were also injured.

Country and location: Ecuador, Pastaza, 32 km east of Palora
Notes: A 12-year-old girl died when a wall collapsed on her in Huamboya.
